speak.0: Those who dare step into the Valley of the Dragons will pay a dire price.
One bogged down by memories can never step forward...
You who walk in the steps of regret...the end will leave only regrets...
You who walk the path of oblivion...you will have to take responsibility for your decisions.
No... To such a worthless being... It can't be!

speak.1: All right, then. I'll see you again sometime.
